game_title: Divide Or Floor – Ash Rim Trail Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split obsidian shards evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: In Ash Rim Trail, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split obsidian shards evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about share to power up the fire warden and open the magma valve.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Ash Rim Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
